response.sql: WITH proj AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS fund_avg FROM proj) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - fund_avg AS margin FROM m ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A project's X-to-Z ratio is the average of the per-record boxx/boxz ratios over its spatial records. Records with a NULL boxx or boxz, or with boxz = 0, are ignored.

The funding-source average is the simple (unweighted) mean of the project-level ratios in that source. Projects with no ratio are excluded from that mean. Projects with a NULL funding source form their own group.
Projects with matching spatial records but no usable ratio stay in the result with a NULL margin, so they sort last. Projects with no spatial records do not appear.
Margin is the project's ratio minus its funding-source average, and the output is not rounded.

alternatives.interpretation: A project's ratio is total boxx divided by total boxz, summed over its spatial records that have both values non-null and boxz non-zero. This weights larger boxes more heavily than the average of per-record ratios does.
alternatives.sql: WITH proj AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS fund_avg FROM proj) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - fund_avg AS margin FROM m ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
